subject: Cannot unstall shiny package on Vbox Linux Ubuntu Server 12.04

messages.author: 3a28b296167ce88d
messages.subject: Cannot unstall shiny package on Vbox Linux Ubuntu Server 12.04
parts:
Hi Everyone,

Every time I try to run 

$ sudo su - \
    -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

I get an 

Error: package RJSONIO was built before R 3.0.0: please re-install it
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package shiny

I have gone trough all the steps in the tutoral, and I even added a line 

   deb http://http://cran.case.edu//bin/linux/ubuntu precise/

into the source list file. It worked because it updated r-base and cleared up a lot of other errors it was having, but the RJSONO error will just not go away. 
I am worried that I have really messed something up, because I continued with the instalation because I did not notice the package did not install in the first place. 
Does anyone have any ideas that might help?
